Educational mineral specimen collection arranged in a compartmented display tray.

Mineral samples carry numbered identification stickers corresponding to the hardness scale.

Each pen has a slim design with a gold tone finish, black plastic end caps, and the Cross pocket clip. The pens are in very good condition with minimal wear and original Cross stickers on the clips. Cross is a well-known brand established in 1846, recognized for quality writing instruments.

As a special accent, the set also contains a charming small red heart-shaped stone to add a touch of whimsy and contrast to your assortment. Perfect for anyone fascinated by geology or metaphysical properties, this assortment allows you to experience a diverse array of stones in their pure form. Whether you're planning a creative project, expanding a collection, or gifting to a loved one, this mixed gemstone lot combines beauty, versatility, and genuine earth-born appeal. Your purchase supports the authenticity of the minerals, with eco-friendly packaging and careful handling for safe delivery.
